notes: Surface Chemistry topic list covers only adsorption thermodynamics and colloids; no catalysis topic exists. Chapter choice itself (Surface Chemistry) is appropriate for catalysis.
States of Matter lists only Graham's Law, Real Gases/van der Waals, Dalton's Law and Gas Laws; none covers types of intermolecular forces.

Chemistry in Everyday Life lists only Analgesics, Antiseptics and Disinfectants, Antibiotics, and Cleansing Agents - Soaps and Detergents; tranquilizers (drugs acting on the nervous system) are missing.
Environmental Chemistry lists only 'Unspecified Topic' and 'Air Pollution'; eutrophication belongs under Water Pollution.
